_ack_id.description: Acknowledgement ID for tracking event delivery (UUID)

_trigger_source_type.description: The type of system that triggered the event. Examples: api, automation, operation, portal_user

_trigger_source.description: Identifier of the specific trigger source. Examples: user ID, automation execution ID, activity ID, portal user email

_automation_chain.description: Ordered automation flow ids that caused this event; propagated verbatim for automation loop prevention

_has_pending_changesets.description: True when the triggering entity (or meter counter) has at least one pending changeset

_changeset_edit_modes.description: Distinct edit modes across the PENDING changesets — only "external" (synced from an external system) or "approval" (awaiting approval). A "direct" write is applied immediately, is not a pending changeset, and so never appears here.

_changeset_attributes.description: Keys identifying pending changesets. For attribute changesets these are attribute names (e.g. `billing_cycle`); for meter-reading changesets these are the changeset IDs from `meter._meter_readings_changeset`

_changeset_edit_modes_by_attribute.description: Per-key edit mode map; keys are a subset of _changeset_attributes (attribute names for entity changesets, changeset IDs for meter-reading changesets) — only those whose pending changeset has an "external" or "approval" mode. A "direct"/unrecognised mode is omitted here, though the key still appears in _changeset_attributes. Enables fine-grained webhook conditions such as `_changeset_edit_modes_by_attribute.billing_cycle equals approval`

message_id.description: Entity ID of the message that failed

thread_id.description: Entity ID of the thread the message belongs to

sender.description: Email address the message was sent from (the mailbox to check when sends keep failing)

recipients.description: Recipients this failure is about. BOUNCE/REJECT: only the recipients newly bounced or rejected by this notification. ERROR: every recipient, because the send itself failed.

status.description: BOUNCE: the recipient mail server returned the email. REJECT: the email was rejected before sending. ERROR: the email could not be sent (e.g. Outlook or SMTP connection error).

error_detail.description: Provider error text: bounce diagnostic code, reject reason or send error

provider.description: Sending provider of the message, e.g. "outlook". Absent for emails sent by epilot.

email_message_id.description: RFC 5322 Message-ID header of the email, to correlate with mail server logs

sent_by_user_id.description: epilot user ID of the person who sent the email

thread_topic.description: Topic of the thread the message belongs to

inbox_bucket_id.description: Inbox bucket of the thread (see GET /v2/email-settings/inbox-buckets)

attribute.description: Message attribute holding the relation, e.g. "ticket"

related_entities.description: Entities the message is related to (tickets, opportunities, contacts, ...), excluding its thread

send_source.description: Who sent the email: "manual" (a user in the inbox), "automation" (an automation, including the emails of a campaign), "workflow", "partner", "bulk" or "system". Absent when the sender was not recorded.

automation_flow_ids.description: IDs of the automation flows behind the email, the flow that sent it last; earlier IDs are the automations whose changes triggered it. A campaign sends its emails through its own flow (the campaign's flow_id). Absent when no automation sent the email or the flow was not recorded.
